children: Polymarket’s submarket for the BLAST Open Porto playoff match between Spirit and Team Falcons saw the “Map 2 Winner” option for Spirit swing sharply, rising from 65.5% an hour earlier to 93.5% at the time of monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 28% increase in the implied win probability and came amid a reported sudden-news impact.

title: Spirit Odds Surge on Polymarket for BLAST Open Porto Playoff Match
